title: Platform refresh token, when a member issues it as a JWT
description: A refresh token is opaque to the frontend and to every component. A member MAY use any format. When it is a JWT signed with a key published in the JWKS, it MUST match this schema, so that it fails a component's verification twice over: typ is refresh, and aud is the issuer itself, never TENANT_ID (TOKENS.md, 'Refresh token').

exp.description: Never later than the session's absolute end (login time + REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS); rotation never extends a session.

sid.description: The session (rotation family) id: the same across rotations; reuse of a rotated jti revokes every token of the sid.
